_comment: Feature tracking file inspired by Anthropic's long-running agent research. JSON is used because LLMs are less likely to accidentally modify JSON compared to Markdown.

metadata.note: Re-verified 2026-09-04. feat-recipe-translation marked failing (script exists, never executed).

features.description: Structured recipe format with YAML frontmatter validation
steps: Recipe files follow YAML + Markdown structure
Metadata includes: title, difficulty, time, servings, ingredients
Validation runs on commit via markdownlint

features.description: Scientific ingredient metadata with nutritional information
steps: Each ingredient has: scientific name, nutrition facts, aliases

features.description: Static site generation with Astro 5.x + Svelte
steps: Astro reads from dishes/ and ingredients/
features.notes: Build successful: 130 pages generated, 103 recipes indexed

features.description: Static i18n catalog: 20 canonical locales, aliases schema, sitemap hreflang, /api/v1/translate prerendered (no SSR)
steps: site/src/lib/locales.ts defines 20 canonical locales + aliases schema
site/src/pages/api/v1/translate.ts prerenders full catalog at build (output static)
sitemap.xml exposes hreflang en/es/x-default; consumers filter client-side
Supersedes Gemini batch approach (#250 static catalog, #251 honest docs, PR #238-#251)
features.notes: Verified 2026-09-06: dist/api/v1/translate holds 987 entities, 20 supported_locales; src/lib/translateService.test.ts + locales.test.ts pass (39/39 vitest). Full-recipe Gemini batch abandoned by design (static-first, no SSR).

features.description: Automatic reporting of protocol improvements to upstream repo
steps: Weekly workflow scans for protocol-improvement label

verification_commands.all: npm run lint && npm run build
